# subject prefix

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:subjectPrefix`](gmeow-subjectPrefix.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/subjectPrefix>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A prefix stripped from a message subject during normalization (e.g. 'Re:', 'Fwd:', 'AW:'). A single message may have multiple nested prefixes, so this property is not functional.
